102.title: Dancing Village: The Curse Begins
102.desc: A mysterious presence called Badarawuhi terrorizes the citizens of a remote Indonesian village

103.title: Trikala: Script of God (2026)
103.desc: Shiva hunts for the 'Script of God' amid a conflict of faith and myth, while uncovering secrets that could help him save humanity from a sinister ancient power.

104.title: Bhay: The Gaurav Tiwari Mystery
104.desc: Gaurav Tiwari, a paranormal investigator, faces his greatest challenge when his pursuit of the truth behind unexplained phenomena leads him into a deadly spiral. As his mysterious death leaves questions unanswered, a journalist delves into his eerie and celebrated legacy, unearthing secrets that blur the line between reality and the supernatural.
